about: Live channels Elixir auto-watches out of the box. Deliberately short: only streams that move markets or spawn memecoin plays. 'auto': true transcribes as soon as it goes live; false just pings you. Scheduled streams from these channels show under Upcoming. 24/7 news channels are left out (always live, so they'd transcribe nonstop). X live broadcasts and Spaces from VIP accounts (Elon, Trump, Ansem…) start automatically from their tweets. 'walletName' links a streamer to wallets in your KOL list by name (dv → dv, dv2, dv3, DV NEW): when they say 'the coin I'm in', Elixir shows what those wallets just bought.
